def stats(values,mask):
    values=np.asarray(values,dtype=np.float64)[mask]
    check(np.isfinite(values).all(),'Invalid finite metric')
    if not len(values): return dict(count=0,mean=None,p50=None,p90=None,min=None,max=None)
    ordered=np.sort(values)
    def percentile(q):
        position=(len(ordered)-1)*q;low=int(math.floor(position));high=int(math.ceil(position))
        return float(ordered[low]+(ordered[high]-ordered[low])*(position-low))
